title: Targets
forbiddenText: You do not have permission to view targets.

actions.cannotDeleteSubmitted: Submitted targets cannot be deleted while awaiting approval.

form.subjectTypeHint: Choose whether this target applies to a user, a team, a branch, or a set of teams.
form.branchHint: Select the branch for this target or to filter users and teams.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectHint: The user or team assigned to achieve this target.
form.teamsHint: Select between 2 and 50 teams covered by this target.
form.metricHint: The CRM performance metric measured against this target.
form.measureHint: Automatically determined by the selected metric (Money, Count, or Rate).
form.periodGrainHint: The recurring time granularity of the target period: monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
form.periodStartHint: Choose the month, quarter, or year when this target period begins.
form.currencyHint: Targets of different currencies are kept separate and never summed together.
form.targetValueHint: Positive goal amount. Counts must be whole numbers; rates must be at most 100%.
form.targetValueApprovedHint: Editing an approved target value returns it to Draft and requires re-approval.
form.targetValueLockedHint: Submitted targets cannot be edited while awaiting approval.
form.reviewNoteHint: Feedback recorded by the reviewer when approving or rejecting this target.
